answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable stake through verified tasks, releasing rewards only after a challenge period. Influence grows slowly over a long horizon, so creating many identities cannot instantly multiply voting power. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed, turning a spiral of disposable accounts into a liability. The attacker must lock real capital and spend time rebuilding trust; each exposed account can send a ripple of losses through its coordinated operation.
